sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुर्धर्षो भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम् ।तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबाहुः शयनादुत्पपात ह ।। ६.६०.९१ ।।।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastu durdharṣo bhrāturājñāya śāsanam ।tathetyuktvā mahābāhuḥ śayanādutpapāta ha ।। 6.60.91 ।।।।

translations.english: By the order of Ravana hurriedly they got several kinds of wine in pots.
